title: Option to enable or disable "Automatically enable audio for newly connected devices" behavior
line: Sound settings now have an option to stop newly connected audio devices from becoming the default automatically.
explanation: On PipeWire, WirePlumber makes a newly connected device the default whenever its priority is higher than the current default's and no device the user chose is available, so a USB or Bluetooth headset takes over as soon as it is plugged in. WirePlumber has no setting for this and the KCM's only related option drives a PulseAudio module that is hidden on PipeWire. The change adds an "Automatically switch to newly connected devices" option to the KCM's Configure… menu that toggles a WirePlumber setting, node.switch-to-new-default-targets, with wpctl. Until WirePlumber has that setting, plasma-pa installs a WirePlumber configuration fragment and a small hook that provide it: when off, the current default is ranked above any device priority but below the user's own selections, so nothing is stored or pinned.

commits.message:
kcm: add an option to not switch to newly connected devices

WirePlumber always made a newly connected device with a higher priority
the default. The new option toggles a WirePlumber setting to keep the
current one, provided by a hook here until WirePlumber has it itself.

BUG: 516683

media.caption: Sound settings on PipeWire: no Configure… menu, so no way to turn automatic switching off
New Configure… menu with "Automatically switch to newly connected devices", here unchecked
Plugging in a USB headset while the built-in speakers play: the headset becomes the default
Same with the option unchecked: the speakers stay the default, the headset is just listed
Option still unchecked: after choosing the headset, unplugging it (back to the speakers) and plugging it in again, the chosen headset comes back

review.text: The behaviour comes from WirePlumber's default-node policy, which is not KDE, so the real fix belongs upstream; the prepared WirePlumber patch is the right direction. Shipping a WirePlumber Lua hook and a settings schema in WirePlumber's own node.* namespace from plasma-pa ties it to WirePlumber internals (hook names that WirePlumber master has already renamed to default-streams), can clash with whatever upstream eventually adds, and is something plasma-pa maintainers are unlikely to accept. The KCM toggle through wpctl, hidden when the setting doesn't exist, is fine as the Plasma side once WirePlumber has the setting.
changes: File the WirePlumber issue/patch upstream (gitlab.freedesktop.org/pipewire/wireplumber, against master with the default-streams naming) and get the setting name agreed there.

Drop the vendored 90-plasma-pa-default-nodes.conf and find-current-default-node.lua from plasma-pa; keep only the KCM toggle (WirePlumberSetting), using the key upstream adopts, shown only when WirePlumber reports the setting.
